title: WHAT THE 2026-09-27 VENUE CLOCK PROBE OBSERVED

a_conclusion_this_file_previously_assert.withdrawn_claim: marketData.transactTime tracks the LAST BOOK CHANGE
why_it_was_not_valid: At least two mechanisms predict the identical observation. (a) the stamp is a last-change stamp and the six markets were genuinely quiet. (b) an intermediary cache served the same stored representation to both reads, in which case the stamp and the book are identical because they are literally the same bytes and nothing about the live book was observed.
The probe captured NO response header on either read, so the presence of a cache in the path was neither shown nor excluded.

Two hypotheses making the same prediction cannot be separated by the observation that confirms both. No number of further unchanged samples helps: each additional identical pair is equally well explained by either.
a_conclusion_this_file_previously_assert.what_was_changed_on_the_strength_of_it_a: the admission gate was moved off the venue stamp onto our own receipt instant, with a 10 s bound, and returned fresh: true on that alone. That admits a snapshot generated four minutes ago, returned in 20 ms and decided on one second later.

what_ran.method: each contract read twice, the two reads about twenty seconds apart

what_this_establishes: That on these six contracts, in this one window, two reads about twenty seconds apart returned the same transactTime value and the same order book. That is the whole of it.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: Whether an intermediary cache is in the request path. Neither shown nor excluded, because no header was captured.
That the six markets were quiet. Unchanged bytes are consistent with a quiet market and with the same bytes being replayed.
That our own receipt instant is a sufficient freshness test. It is not: it cannot detect a cached payload, and the faster the response the stronger the false certificate it would issue.
That any freshness bound may be moved in any direction. It supports no policy change.
why_more_samples_cannot_close_it: The competing hypotheses make the same prediction for this experiment. Resolving it requires a mechanism with a published contract, not a larger sample.

M1_LIVE_MARKET_DATA_SUBSCRIPTION.what_it_establishes: On a subscription proven alive within the liveness bound, the last update received for a market IS the venue's book state: any change since would have been pushed.
M1_LIVE_MARKET_DATA_SUBSCRIPTION.status: AVAILABLE AND NOT YET WIRED INTO THIS LANE. The repository already speaks the protocol (bettor_market_stream, obs/streamstate, the SDK's markets websocket). The EV lane does not subscribe.
M1_LIVE_MARKET_DATA_SUBSCRIPTION.work_required: subscribe the lane's mapped candidates to SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE_MARKET_DATA, keep per-slug last-update and connection-liveness instants, and pass them to venue_quote(subscription=...).

M2_CONDITIONAL_REVALIDATION.what_it_establishes: A 304 Not Modified to an If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since on the book path is the origin affirming that the representation we hold is still current, as of that response's Date. RFC 9110 §13, RFC 9111 §4.3.
M2_CONDITIONAL_REVALIDATION.status: UNKNOWN UNTIL HEADERS ARE READ. Requires the book endpoint to emit ETag or Last-Modified.
M2_CONDITIONAL_REVALIDATION.work_required: the v3 probe reports revalidation_possible per read. If a validator is emitted, issue the conditional request and pass the result to venue_quote(revalidation=...).

M3_ORIGIN_GENERATION_INSTANT.what_it_establishes: Date minus Age is when the origin generated the stored representation (RFC 9111 §5.1, §6.1). Inside the bound and not cache-served, it establishes that THIS RESPONSE is newly generated.
M3_ORIGIN_GENERATION_INSTANT.status: PARTIAL BY CONSTRUCTION AND NEVER SUFFICIENT ALONE. It bounds the response, not the matching engine's book: an origin can generate a fresh response now from an internal snapshot computed minutes ago.
M3_ORIGIN_GENERATION_INSTANT.also_decisive_in_the_negative: Date minus Age outside the bound, or Age past the response's own max-age, is the CONTRACT stating the payload is old. That refuses on evidence rather than on absence.

what_changed_in_the_code_because_of_this: bettor_venue_currency.py: three verdicts (ESTABLISHED / NOT_ESTABLISHED / CONTRADICTED), three named mechanisms, and an explicit refusal to derive currency from transport latency, from our own receipt instant, or from repeated identical samples.

venue_http_observer.py: one httpx response hook on the SDK's own client recording a fixed whitelist of metadata headers, because the SDK ends its request with response.json() and discards all of them.

workers/ext_pinnacle_loop.py: VENUE_STAMP_SEMANTICS is UNRESOLVED; the stamp is carried as provenance and decides nothing in either direction; admission requires an established currency verdict AND our processing delay inside its bound, neither sufficient alone.
the admin probe is V3 and captures the response contract, which is the evidence that can actually decide the question.
the_lane_still_refuses_and_this_is_the_h: With no subscription and no revalidation wired, every venue read reaches BOOK_CURRENCY_NOT_ESTABLISHED and the candidate refuses. That is missing evidence, named, and not a claim that any book was stale. It is also not a completed delivery: closing it is M1.
